project: Kosi River Basin VGAE-only five-event SAR/FIM validation
score: For each basin, pixel-weighted flood fraction of all other valid-FIM basins in the same original VGAE cluster.
binary_metric_threshold: Median LOBO score within each event and target; descriptive only.
interpretation: Retrospective spatial association, not prospective independent prediction. Cluster-derived scores share spatial structure and are event-specific.
